theorems.name: Submission.dph_iprod_current_of_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (P q : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (T₀ : TestFormOn U q →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (B : ℝ), 0 ≤ B → (∀ (ω : TestFormOn U q) (C : ℝ), (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) q) x) ≤ C) → |T₀ ω| ≤ B * C) → ∃ T : GeometricCurrentOn U q, (∀ ω, T ω = T₀ ω) ∧ T.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal B
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
